# Creating grid for oregon

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r}
# importing libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(sf)
```

```{r}
landmark <- st_read("/Users/nikolefiden/Desktop/DATA-510/Indigenous_comm_lands_v202509/LandMark_IPLC_poly_public_v202509.shp")
landmark <- st_zm(landmark)
```

## OR

```{r}
states <- usmap::us_map()
or <- states %>% filter(abbr=="OR")
# transforming OR so the coordinate system matches
or <- st_transform(or, crs=st_crs(landmark))

or %>% 
    ggplot() +
    geom_sf() + 
    theme_minimal()
```

## Create grid

```{r}
or_grid_square <- st_make_grid(or, cellsize=0.05)
plot(or_grid_square)
plot(st_geometry(or), add=TRUE)
plot(or_grid_square[or], col="#ff000088", add=TRUE)
```

## add names/identifier to each grid cell

```{r}
head(or_grid_square)
or_grid = or_grid_square[or]
length(or_grid_square)
length(or_grid)
```

```{r}
index = seq(1, length(or_grid), 1)
index_tib = tibble(index)

or_grid_df <- cbind(or_grid, index_tib)


st_transform(or_grid, crs=st_crs(landmark))
```

# Add landmark data

```{r}
lm_int = st_intersects(or, landmark)
dim(lm_int)

or_lm = us_lm[unlist(lm_int),]
dim(or_lm)
```

```{r}
indigenous <- st_intersects(or_grid, or_lm, sparse=FALSE)
indigenous_tibble <- tibble(indigenous)

or_grid_df <- cbind(or_grid_df, indigenous_tibble)

or_grid_df <- or_grid_df %>%
    mutate(across(starts_with("indigenous"), ~ ifelse(.x==TRUE, 1, 0))) %>% 
    mutate(
        is_indigenous = ifelse(rowSums(across(starts_with("indigenous"))) == 0, 0, 1)
    )

lengths(or_grid_df)

```

# Add IFPH data

```{r}
ifph <- st_read("/Users/nikolefiden/Desktop/DATA-510/InterAgencyFirePerimeterHistory_All_Years_View/InteragencyFirePerimeterHistory.shp")

```

```{r}
ifph <- st_transform(ifph, st_crs(landmark))

ifph <- st_make_valid(ifph)

```

```{r}
ifph_int = st_intersects(or, ifph)
dim(ifph_int)

or_ifph = ifph[unlist(ifph_int),]
dim(or_ifph)

or_ifph %>% 
    ggplot() + geom_sf() + theme_minimal()

```

## locked in. adding fire identifier

```{r}

head(or_grid)
head(or_ifph)
has_fire <- st_intersects(or_grid, or_ifph, sparse=FALSE)
head(has_fire)
dim(has_fire)
fire_tibble <- tibble(has_fire)

fire_tibble %>% filter(has_fire[,100]==TRUE)

or_grid_df <- cbind(or_grid_df, indigenous_tibble)

```
